name: RAG-Visualizer
description: A visual sandbox for experimenting with RAG configurations. Interactive tools for document parsing, chunking, embeddings, and retrieval testing, all running locally.

paragraphs: Unravel is an interactive tool to visualize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines. It helps developers understand, debug, and optimize their RAG systems through real-time visual inspection of document parsing, chunking, embeddings, and retrieval steps.

Unravel is designed for developers who want to visualize RAG workflows and experiment with different configurations locally. Whether you are testing new chunking strategies, comparing embedding models, or fine-tuning retrieval parameters, Unravel provides the visual clarity needed to build better RAG applications.
features: 📁 File Upload: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, Markdown, TXT, and Images (PNG, JPG, BMP, TIFF)
🌐 URL Scraping: Extract content from web pages with JavaScript rendering support
Crawl Modes: Single page scraping or multi-page crawling
Discovery Methods: Crawler (follows internal links), Sitemap, or Feeds (RSS/Atom)
Extraction Modes: Balanced, Favor Precision, or Favor Recall

requirements.text: Unravel can use hosted LLM providers (API key) or a local/self-hosted LLM (OpenAI-compatible server).
Recommended: Start with Groq (GROQAPIKEY) — it’s usually the fastest path to “it works”, and does not require adding a credit card to get started.
Note: Local servers typically don’t require a real API key.
